# Toastty

## A terminal worth showing.

A GPU-accelerated Rust terminal for text, images, documents, and 3D. ([Toastty](https://github.com/EDToaster/toastty))

This presentation is the demo.

`Space` next · `←` back · `q` quit

---

## Keep the terminal. Expand the canvas.

Your shell and terminal tools, with rich output alongside them. ([Toastty](https://github.com/EDToaster/toastty))

![Product screenshot: Toastty running tmux with Vim and a colored Git log](data:image/png;base64,)

## Documents, not walls of text

Headings, tables, checklists, and highlighted code render inline. ([Markdown guide](https://github.com/EDToaster/toastty/blob/main/docs/markdown.md))

### Launch checklist

| Work | State | Next step |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Product tour | Ready | Show the terminal |
| Diagram | Ready | Explain the flow |
| Follow-up | Open | Try it yourself |

- [x] Keep the document next to the code
- [x] Present the same Markdown without exporting slides

```sh
toastty md notes.md
cat notes.md | toastty md
```

<!-- Presenter: the checklist is illustrative demo content. This slide is live Markdown, not a screenshot. Hover over the block to reveal Copy Markdown. -->

## Diagrams stay in the conversation

Mermaid source becomes a native diagram, without a browser renderer. ([Markdown guide](https://github.com/EDToaster/toastty/blob/main/docs/markdown.md))

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    A[Write Markdown] --> B[Run toastty md]
    B --> C[Read the diagram]
    C --> D[Keep working]
```

This flowchart is rendered from the deck's own fenced code.

<!-- Presenter: this is a deliberately short diagram, not a claim of perfect layout for arbitrary graphs. Resize briefly to demonstrate relayout, then restore the window. -->

## Show the interaction, too

Sequence diagrams can explain a request without leaving the terminal. ([Markdown guide](https://github.com/EDToaster/toastty/blob/main/docs/markdown.md))

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant CLI
    participant API
    CLI->>API: Submit job
    API-->>CLI: Job accepted
```

<!-- Presenter: an illustrative application flow, not Toastty's internal architecture. Like the previous slide, this is live Mermaid source. -->

## Pictures belong beside the command

Kitty graphics and Sixel bring images into terminal workflows. ([Toastty](https://github.com/EDToaster/toastty))

![Product screenshot: Yazi browsing fractal images inside Toastty](data:image/png;base64,)

```sh
toastty image photo.png
toastty image --sixel photo.png
```

<!-- Presenter: the existing product screenshot shows a Yazi image preview. The slide image itself uses Markdown's embedded PNG support, not a new Kitty transmission. -->

## A terminal with another dimension

The Ratty Graphics Protocol lets apps send 3D meshes for live GPU rendering. ([Toastty](https://github.com/EDToaster/toastty))

![Static product capture: the molecule-viewer demo displaying a caffeine model](data:image/png;base64,)

Static capture above; the bundled demo supports mouse rotation and zoom. ([Toastty](https://github.com/EDToaster/toastty))

```sh
cargo run --release -p molecule-viewer
```

<!-- Presenter: run the command from the repository in a separate direct Toastty window if you want the interactive demo. This deck does not execute commands or embed an interactive 3D viewport. -->

## Give the terminal a different texture

Chain GLSL or WGSL post-processing shaders, with live reload on save. ([Toastty](https://github.com/EDToaster/toastty))

![Static product capture: CRT styling on terminal output](data:image/png;base64,)

```toml
[shader]
paths = ["shaders/splitflap.glsl", "shaders/crt.glsl"]
```

<!-- Presenter: this is a static frame from the existing CRT/split-flap demo, not an effect applied to this deck. Shader files must exist next to the config as documented in the README. -->

---

## Resize the window, not your thinking

Soft-wrapped text reflows as the window changes width. ([Toastty](https://github.com/EDToaster/toastty))

![Product screenshot: the same paragraph reflowing from a wide window to a narrow one](data:image/png;base64,)

Smooth scrollback for everyday reading; experimental smooth TUI regions require app opt-in. ([Toastty](https://github.com/EDToaster/toastty))

<!-- Presenter: the image is an existing before-and-after screenshot. Normal scrollback and experimental alternate-screen regions are different features; do not imply every TUI automatically gets smooth panes. -->

## Rich output. Familiar foundations.

Modern protocols and everyday text handling underneath the visuals. ([Toastty](https://github.com/EDToaster/toastty))

| Layer | What Toastty brings |
| --- | --- |
| Text | Ligatures, font fallback, wide scripts |
| Input | Kitty keyboard protocol and mouse reporting |
| Rendering | Synchronized output and grapheme clusters |
| Shell | Working directory and semantic prompt integration |
| Workflow | Clickable links, clipboard, font zoom |

```rust
let readable = text != noise && context >= 1;
```

<!-- Presenter: the code is a typography sample, not an API. Toastty has known compatibility gaps; this slide is not a claim of universal application compatibility. -->

---

## The presentation is a plain text file

`toastty present` uses the same Markdown renderer, one slide at a time. ([Presenter guide](https://github.com/EDToaster/toastty/blob/main/docs/present.md))

```sh
toastty present toastty-demo.md
```

| Action | Keys |
| --- | --- |
| Next / previous | Space / ← |
| Jump to a slide | Number, then Enter |
| First / last | g / G |
| Reload / quit | r / q |

Edit and save to reload; resize or zoom to reflow. ([Presenter guide](https://github.com/EDToaster/toastty/blob/main/docs/present.md))

# Less switching. More showing.

Try a document. Show a diagram. Present an idea.

```sh
toastty md notes.md
toastty image photo.png
toastty present toastty-demo.md
```

Build and install with `make install` from the repository. ([Get Toastty](https://github.com/EDToaster/toastty))
